agents.name: Data Capture – Reports
agents.role: Downloads each company's quarterly and annual reports into the local reports folder as soon as they are published.
agents.trigger: A listed company publishes a quarterly or annual report.
agents.output: Report file saved locally, one file per company per period.
agents.fills: Financial Data: Download Agent, Report Available, Downloaded On
checks: File name: StockCode_CompanyName_PeriodEnd_Q or _AR (e.g. 1155_Maybank_2026-09-30_Q)
Report Available = date on the announcement, not the download date
Downloaded On recorded with date and time (MYT)
No duplicate file for the same company + period
File opens and holds the financial statements, not a cover page only
Hand-off: tell Data Extraction – Reports which files are new
agents.onFailure: Retry up to 3 times. If still failing (site down, file missing, file corrupt), log a Failed run with the error and the action needed.

agents.name: Data Capture – Target Price
agents.role: Collects analyst target price calls from Telegram channels and company websites.
agents.trigger: A new target price post or update appears on a watched Telegram channel or company website.
agents.input: Telegram channels and company / IR websites on the watch list.
agents.output: Saved post or page (screenshot or text) with its link and published time.
agents.fills: Target Price: Published On, Captured On, Source Link, Capture Agent
checks: Keep the original post or page, with its link
Published On = time of the post, not the capture time
Skip reposts of a call already captured (same source, company, price and date)
Hand-off: tell Data Extraction – Target Price what is new
agents.onFailure: Retry up to 3 times. If a channel or site cannot be reached, or a post cannot be read, log a Failed run.

agents.name: Data Capture – News
agents.role: Collects news about the tracked companies.
agents.trigger: New article or announcement about a tracked company.
agents.output: Saved article with its link and published time.
agents.fills: News: Published On, Captured On, Link, Capture Agent
checks: Only companies already in Financial Data (or the watch list)
Published On = time of the article
One article once: skip duplicates of the same link or headline
Hand-off: tell Data Extraction – News what is new
agents.onFailure: Retry up to 3 times. If a source cannot be reached, log a Failed run.

agents.name: Data Extraction – Reports
agents.role: Reads each quarterly and annual report and writes every statement line into Financial Data.
agents.trigger: Data Capture – Reports hands over new files.
agents.input: Report files from Data Capture – Reports.
agents.output: One row per statement line in Financial Data.
agents.fills: Financial Data: Company Name, Stock Code, Data Item, Statement Line, Value, Period End, As Of, Market, Industry, Last Updated, Updated By, Extract Agent, Download Delay
checks: Stock Code as text so leading zeros stay (e.g. 0166)
Data Item is one of: Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement, Changes in Equity
Statement Line exactly as the report labels it
Value as a plain number; losses negative; same unit as the report
As Of: 2026-Q3 for quarterly, FY2026 for annual
Totals tie out: total assets = equity + liabilities; net profit matches the report
Never overwrite an older period: a restated figure is a new row with a new As Of
agents.onFailure: If a file cannot be read or totals do not tie out, write nothing for that company and log a Failed run.

agents.name: Data Extraction – Target Price
agents.role: Records each target price call in the Target Price table.
agents.trigger: Data Capture – Target Price hands over new posts.
agents.input: Saved posts and pages from Data Capture – Target Price.
agents.output: One row per call in Target Price.
agents.fills: Target Price: Company Name, Stock Code, Target Price, Call, Analyst / Source, Channel, Delay, Extract Agent, Last Updated, Updated By
checks: Target Price as a number in RM
Call is Buy, Hold or Sell only
Analyst / Source names the house or analyst
A new call from the same source is a new row; never overwrite the old one
agents.onFailure: If the price, company or source is unclear, write nothing for it and log a Failed run.

agents.name: Data Extraction – News
agents.role: Records each news item, with a short summary, in the News table.
agents.trigger: Data Capture – News hands over new articles.
agents.input: Saved articles from Data Capture – News.
agents.output: One row per article in News.
agents.fills: News: Company Name, Stock Code, Headline, Summary, Category, Source, Delay, Extract Agent, Last Updated, Updated By
checks: Headline exactly as published
Summary in 1 to 2 sentences, facts only
Category is one of: Earnings, Corporate Action, Contract / Deal, Management, Regulatory, Other
One row per article; never duplicate a link
agents.onFailure: If an article cannot be read or matched to a company, log a Failed run.
